title: Chapter 211 Being Tricked
content:
Chapter 211 Being Tricked

Standing at the foot of the mountain, Lu Xue and his others seemed extremely small.

"Is this the ancestral land of your Xiao clan?"

There was a little more shock in Lu Xue's eyes.

On the side, Xiao Chen nodded proudly, "This is the ancestral land of my Xiao clan."

At this time, two figures slowly walked towards them from a distance.

Lu Xue looked closely and saw a figure that was Xiao Xuanmu, while the other figure was an old man who was even older than Xiao Chen and the others.

"That's the elder of my clan."

At this time, Xiao Chen, who was beside him, whispered.

Great Elder?

No wonder I didn’t see it when I entered the Xiao clan.

Lu Xue thought so in her heart.

"Are you the reinforcements found by Xiao Chen and the others?"

Xiao Jing, the elder of the Xiao clan, spoke.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded, "It's me."

Seeing Lu Xue admitting generously, Xiao Jing stared at Lu Xue for a long time, then slowly said: "Originally, according to the rules of my Xiao clan, outsiders were forbidden to enter the ancestral land, but now, our clan naturally cannot come in the same way as before. ”

"Girl, if you want to solve the crisis of my Xiao clan and figure out what is going on in the ancestral land, you must enter the ancestral land."

"Do you dare?"

Xiao Jing said in a heavy voice.

Hearing this, Lu Xue did not hesitate at all.

"What's the point of not daring?"

You can't embarrass Huangcheng, let alone embarrass your parents.

"You have to know that for thousands of years, all those who have entered my Xiao clan's ancestral land, whether they are Xiao clan or outsiders, have lost contact and have never come out again."

"They are probably all dead."

Xiao Jing continued, as if he wanted to let Lu Xue retreat.

However, he underestimated Lu Xue.

"They are them, I am me, and they can't do it, it doesn't mean I can't do it."

Looking at Lu Xue's confident gaze, Xiao Jing immediately smiled.

"If you can really solve the crisis of my Xiao clan, then I Xiao clan will be very grateful."

"I, Xiao clan, are willing to fulfill the bet between Xiao Chen and you before."

"Of course, the premise of all this is that you can really solve the crisis of my Xiao clan."

Xiao Jing said with a smile.

This is difficult, because now, the crisis of the Xiao clan is not just about the ancestral land, but also about the threats of the other forces in the fairyland. These are all the crises of the Xiao clan.

Lu Xue obviously also heard what Xiao Jing meant.

"Is it wrong for you to do this?"

Upon hearing this, Xiao Jing smiled, but said nothing.

Xiao Chen smiled bitterly, "Miss Lu, sorry."

He couldn't decide anything now, but the decision of the elder of the Xiao clan was indeed right.

At least for them Xiao clan.

Seeing this, Lu Xue sighed.

"Forget it, I don't care whether you Xiao clan joins my Huangcheng or not. I'm here this time just to prove myself to my parents."

Since you are like this, Lu Xue won’t say much.

Just treat it as the previous lesson.

The conditions of the Xiao clan are very harsh, and although Lu Xue can do it, why is Lu Xue?

Owe them?

Lu Xue doesn't plan to do those extra things.

Now, Lu Xue is still willing to solve their problems for the Xiao clan, and it is already a perfect end to be kind and righteous.

It can also be regarded as accumulating some merits.

"Did I go in alone?"

Lu Xue walked to the foot of the mountain, looked at the hazy mountain in front of her, and then spoke.

At this time, Xiao Jing walked to Lu Xue.

"This is a communicator and this ring. Although I don't know if this communicator is useful, you should still hold it."

Xiao Jing handed two things to Lu Xue and then spoke.

"If you see that my Xiao clan is still alive inside, give them this ring."

Holding the thing, Lu Xue also understood what Xiao Jing meant.

Looking at the fear deep in the hearts of the few people, Lu Xue sighed slightly in her heart.

Perhaps, the reason for the weakening of the Xiao clan was not this ancestral land, but the increasingly decadent thoughts of the people of the Xiao clan.

If my father is here, he will definitely persuade them.

In the end, Lu Xue stepped into the vast mountain alone.

In just a moment, it was lost.

At the foot of the mountain.

"Great Elder, if something happens to this girl, I'm afraid the forces behind the other party won't give up."

Xiao Xuanmu stepped forward and said with some concern.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Chen remained silent.

The elder of Xiao clan Xiao Jing said with a serious expression: "What kind of force is behind her?"

What force?

Xiao Jing did not know the forces behind Lu Xue, but only learned about it from Xiao Chen.

Hearing the question from the elder of the Xiao clan, Xiao Chen sighed, "The power is not important, what is important is that the girl's parents are not simple characters."

"Isn't it a simple character?"

Xiao Jing frowned slightly.

Xiao Chen was about to continue saying something, but a cold voice suddenly sounded behind the people.

"Are you too much doing my daughter like this?"

In an instant, Xiao Jing and the other two changed their faces and they quickly turned around to look.

when!

I saw a man appearing in the eyes of several people, it was Lu Daosheng.

That's right, from the moment Lu Xue left the Huangcheng, Lu Daosheng had been following him secretly, from Lu Xue winning the bet and going to the Xiao clan of the Immortal Realm, Lu Daosheng took all this into his eyes.

I have to say that Lu Xue has really grown up.

It's really possible to stand alone.

But these people's actions with their daughters still made Lu Daosheng a little dissatisfied, even though this is a cruel reality.

But since Lu Daosheng saw it, he would not do anything.

"Have you met the Lord of the Huang City!"

When Xiao Chen and the others saw Lu Daosheng, they immediately said respectfully.

Xiao Jing looked at Lu Daosheng in front of him with a serious face.

"Are you the Lord of the Wilderness City?"

At this moment, Xiao Jing was already shocked, unable to see through, and at all. Moreover, looking at Lu Daosheng, Xiao Jing felt extremely uncomfortable, as if his life and death had been controlled by others.

How is this possible?

I am a strong man at the ninth level of the Immortal Emperor.

In the Immortal Realm, after reaching the Immortal Emperor Realm, the further you go, the greater the gap between each small realm, especially at the ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Facing a strong man below the ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm, he almost never had to fight. He could fight over the level.

After all, no one who can reach the Immortal Emperor Realm and reach the Ninth Level of the Immortal Emperor Realm is not a genius.

But now, just glanced at the other person, and I felt fear in my heart.

Could it be that the other party is an existence above the Immortal Emperor Realm?

No, it's impossible!

Xiao Jing was shocked by his guess. How could the existence above the Immortal Emperor Realm just see it so casually?

And at this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

"My name is Lu Daosheng, and it is the father of the girl who just entered this mountain."

"You Xiao clan are really brave. Even my daughter, Lu Daosheng, dares to trick her."

Speaking of this, Lu Daosheng showed a sneer on his face, looking very shrill.

Suddenly, Xiao Jing and the other two felt an inexplicable pressure.
